CC: ingrown toenail

HPI: 6 months of symptoms relating to multiple thickened painful nails.

Exam: nails examined consistent with multiple thickened painful nails; general inspection of the foot otherwise unremarkable.

MDM: addressed an independent problem with risks, data review (X-ray pending), and a management plan distinct from the procedure decision; shared decision making documented.

Procedure: Debridement of 6 or more thickened nails performed with sterile technique (RT modifier documented). Tolerated well, no immediate complications.

(End of note.)
